transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Rowan, Maintenance Control Officer. We need to get moving on the quarter-end property reconciliation. The items in scope are the battery packs, rugged tablets, power converters, and electronic test cables currently tagged as unserviceable. Per policy, I need current technical status and disposition recommendations from each responsible section before I can sign the disposition order. Could the responsible sections please confirm the status of these items and provide their recommendations? The available disposition categories are quarantine, reissue, repair, and calibration return.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. The battery shop inspected the six unserviceable battery packs this morning. All six have swollen casings, which are covered by a manufacturer safety bulletin. They must be quarantined rather than repaired. We've scheduled property-office pickup for Wednesday at 1000. I should note that the inspection sheet is still in our shop binder and has not yet been entered in the maintenance control log — we'll get that entered.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. IT support has completed certified data erasure on the eight rugged tablets. They were found serviceable and must be reissued to the training cell with an asset transfer scheduled for Friday at 0900. I should note that the erasure certificates are filed in the IT ticket system but have not yet been attached to the reconciliation packet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. The power systems bench verified the four unserviceable power converters this morning. They have replaceable fan modules and should be sent for repair, with repair-bench priority 2. I should note that the bench verification is complete, but the work-order recommendation has not yet been posted to the maintenance control log.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. The calibration desk confirmed that the ten electronic test cables failed their scheduled calibration check but remain suitable for controlled calibration return. They must be sent to the calibration desk with a calibration request dated Tuesday. I should note that the signed calibration worksheet is complete and is awaiting property-section filing.
transcript.speaker: A5

Ensure signed calibration worksheet is filed with the property section before disposition order is signed.
